description: Unofficial Leafy fan-art animated companion inspired by Battle for Dream Island. A smooth green leaf with one pale vein and two black arms and legs performs original sprout-sheltering, paper-boat nudging and three paper-drop handling motions, with a gentle catch, attentive pause, short hop and three-direction articulated steps. Sprout, boat and drops are safe paper props; plush texture is replaced by clean drawn surfaces. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
